ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90:10 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels on the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation is confined to a continuous thin margin along the trailing edge and dense, irregular pixel clusters at the lateral distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an approximate aperture of 85 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire linear boundary of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical sweep; the right lobe exhibits a strong convex curvature towards the distal tip, while the left lobe displays a flatter, slightly convex profile before occlusion by water splash.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of faint, brownish-grey linear pixel disruptions on the central-right lobe surface, oriented roughly parallel to the longitudinal axis of the fluke.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinctive dark, comb-like vertical striations on the far right distal tip, indicating localized pigmentation irregularity or healed trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pixel occlusion and high-intensity specular highlights caused by water spray at the fluke-peduncle junction, masking approximately 15 percent of the lower central fluke area.
